OPEN QUESTION. The pre-0731 production dspark_drafter was a THIRD-PARTY file: bleysg/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark-drafter-GGUF DSpark-drafter-Q2K-Q8.gguf (6971241504 bytes, sha f98c894c7be92457e40a9f95c689d008ecfe020aec6b082b811860e103ae0504), which docs/ds4-security-review.md audit finding HIGH-2 flagged for having no independent provenance chain and being non-reproducible by the in-tree extractor. bleysg publishes no 0731 drafter, and a drafter must stay token-distribution-compatible with its base, so the old drafter does NOT carry over. This first-party antirez DSpark-support-0731 file is the same-repo, same-provenance analog and is staged as the candidate replacement. Whether ds4-server consumes it directly via DS4_DSPARK_MODEL or whether it must first pass through the in-tree drafter extractor is UNVERIFIED as of this pin.
